item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":1,"rationale":"The President states an Administration policy and recommends conduct by federal personnel, contractors, and visitors; it guides executive implementation without itself imposing a binding legal consequence.","evidence":"It is the policy of my Administration to halt the spread of coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19)"},{"segment_id":"2","code":2,"rationale":"Agency heads must take later implementing action that requires covered employees, contractors, and persons on federal property to comply with CDC public-health guidelines.","evidence":"shall immediately take action, as appropriate and consistent with applicable law, to require compliance with CDC guidelines"},{"segment_id":"3","code":2,"rationale":"Officials must issue implementation guidance and consult, while agency heads choosing exceptions must later impose specified alternative safeguards and document them; the legally consequential requirements arise through agency implementation.","evidence":"they shall require appropriate alternative safeguards"},{"segment_id":"4","code":1,"rationale":"Agency heads must review existing authority and seek, conditionally, to provide masks; this is discretionary administrative implementation rather than a mandated funding or entitlement outcome.","evidence":"shall review their existing authorities"},{"segment_id":"5","code":1,"rationale":"The Coordinator and agency heads must coordinate, report, and engage stakeholders to encourage compliance; these are internal management and outreach activities without a prescribed legal consequence.","evidence":"The COVID-19 Response Coordinator shall coordinate the implementation of this section."},{"segment_id":"6","code":1,"rationale":"The Coordinator and collaborating officials must identify and communicate possible incentives and support, but the segment does not require adoption of any particular option or legal outcome.","evidence":"shall promptly identify and inform agencies of options"},{"segment_id":"7","code":1,"rationale":"The President immediately establishes and organizes an internal executive task force, assigns its membership, and permits delegations and subgroups; this is executive organization and housekeeping.","evidence":"There is hereby established the Safer Federal Workforce Task Force"},{"segment_id":"8","code":1,"rationale":"GSA must supply internal funding and administrative support to the Task Force within existing appropriations, an executive housekeeping assignment rather than a substantive funding release or entitlement.","evidence":"shall provide funding and administrative support for the Task Force"},{"segment_id":"9","code":1,"rationale":"The Co-Chairs must manage the Task Force by holding meetings, setting its agenda, and directing its work; these are internal organizational duties.","evidence":"shall convene regular meetings of the Task Force"},{"segment_id":"10","code":1,"rationale":"The Task Force must develop ongoing operational guidance, and agency heads must report information to it; both are internal guidance and reporting functions, not prescribed binding legal outcomes.","evidence":"The Task Force shall provide ongoing guidance to heads of agencies"},{"segment_id":"11","code":1,"rationale":"HHS, acting through CDC, must develop and submit an internal federal-workforce testing plan; the segment orders planning but does not itself require testing or dictate a binding implementation result.","evidence":"shall promptly develop and submit to the COVID-19 Response Coordinator a testing plan"},{"segment_id":"12","code":1,"rationale":"The OSTP Director must assess grant availability, and the segment defines terms governing this order's internal scope; it neither awards grants nor independently changes substantive legal rights.","evidence":"shall assess the availability of Federal research grants"},{"segment_id":"13","code":1,"rationale":"OPM and GSA officials must seek consultation with legislative and judicial officials to promote public-health practices; this is interbranch outreach without a binding legal consequence.","evidence":"shall seek to consult"},{"segment_id":"14","code":1,"rationale":"The officials must provide requested technical assistance, while the savings clause preserves existing agency and OMB authority; these are implementation support and internal legal housekeeping.","evidence":"shall provide requested technical assistance as needed"}]}
